integrity: Claim is supported by a complete inductive proof and independent small-group exhaustive tests; all tests are finite and are not substitutes for the proof.
scientific_limitations: Asymptotic only for a fixed prime and fixed defect as depth grows; the finite-depth order recurrence and cycle-index consequences are classical, not claimed as novel. Possible earlier equivalent rare-tail expansions remain a historical-priority risk. No independent verification.
title: A sharp factorial law for near-maximal orders in iterated cyclic wreath groups
